data.title: 芙宁娜 · 独奏沙龙午后茶歇
data.description: 午后阳光穿过沙龙的落地窗，留声机旁的茶桌上摆着草莓蛋糕。芙宁娜戴着黑色贝雷帽，身穿深蓝开衫侧坐在雕花扶手椅上，一手托茶碟，另一手把骨瓷杯停在唇边。她的视线追着茶桌上方轻轻跃动的一只小水形幻灵，忍不住笑了起来，连刚才想好的开场白也忘掉了。
data.location: 枫丹私人公寓阳光沙龙
data.action: 侧坐扶手椅，一手托茶碟，一手端杯停在唇边，微笑注视茶桌上方的小水形幻灵。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, tea table included
data.promptProse: A small nonhuman water spirit bobs over the strawberry cake, earning Furina's unguarded smile. She sits sideways in the carved salon armchair, navy cardigan beneath a black beret, supporting a saucer while holding the iris-patterned cup at her lips. The tea table overlaps the chair in the eye-level view; a gramophone stands farther back. Afternoon window light glints through the spirit and along the porcelain, leaving chair carvings shaded.
